runs.cause: ROS_DOMAIN_ID=234 exceeds the supported Fast DDS domain ID limit (232); PX4 participant creation failed before profile probes. No performance or qualification claim.

runs.load: VINS + localization + PX4 and three common read-only probes; no mapping/EGO/navigation
runs.valid_for: clock/RTF diagnostic only; fusion not qualified
runs.failure_interpretation: Localization locked telemetry_stale after a 0.671 s receipt gap in raw VINS telemetry/optimized odometry; PX4 got 85 visual odometry samples but no EV fusion.

runs.load: VINS + localization + PX4 and three common read-only probes; no mapping/EGO/navigation
runs.valid_for: clock/RTF diagnostic only; fusion not qualified
runs.failure_interpretation: At about 2.13 s probe elapsed, /clock and sensor streams had a shared 0.33–0.47 s receipt gap; localization locked propagated_stale. PX4 got 1 visual odometry sample and no EV fusion.

runs.load: VINS + localization + PX4 + depth-health monitor + mapping input adapter + common probes and mapping probe; no plan_env/EGO/navigation process
runs.valid_for: RTF diagnostic only; not an active mapping workload
runs.failure_interpretation: mapping-adapter.log remained at map reset required because plan_env reset service was absent. No occupied map was produced; this run cannot isolate active mapping cost.

runs.load: VINS + localization + PX4 + depth-health monitor + mapping adapter + EGO plan_env/FSM + traj_server + common/mapping read-only probes; no navigation supervisor or navigation trace
runs.valid_for: RTF and fail-closed response diagnostic only; map/flight not qualified
runs.failure_interpretation: A ~0.721 s /clock and IMU receipt gap (source /clock gap 0.016 s) occurred near the start of the probe window; localization locked telemetry_stale, mapping gate closed, no occupied map or PX4 VIO was produced.

combined_findings: Baseline #118/#119 measured RTF 0.4200/0.4189 and observed_offset slopes -0.5798/-0.5816 s per wall second, consistent with #114 and the relationship RTF + abs(offset slope) approximately 1. Both later baseline runs encountered transient input scheduling gaps and did not qualify EV fusion.

#120 measured RTF 0.3636 with depth-health and mapping adapter processes, close to full-load #116 RTF 0.3626; however, plan_env was absent and the mapping adapter stayed behind its reset barrier, so this was not active mapping and does not isolate the cause.

#121 measured RTF 0.3713 with EGO and traj_server, without navigation supervisor; its map reset was observed, but a shared clock/IMU receipt gap was followed by telemetry_stale, mapping gate closure and zero occupancy outputs. It cannot qualify map or PX4 fusion.

The loaded runs correlate lower RTF, larger offset slope and stale input episodes with added work, but observer startup, short runtime, and incomplete active-map windows prevent component-level attribution. No health threshold or offset filter was changed.
All successful launches kept the bridge DISABLED and vehicle disarmed, emitted zero control samples, and used no ROS truth input. No task goal was sent in these ablation runs.

qualification.interpretation: Short passive diagnostics only. No run in this series establishes PX4 EV fusion readiness, active navigation, map quality, trajectory tracking, flight, or the 10-minute P5 acceptance.

limitations: Three ablations failed before useful qualification due domain or transient freshness gates.
#120 had no EGO plan_env reset service and thus no active map processing.
#121 EGO reset did not progress into map output before localization locked.
Common probes and node startup add load; comparisons are correlated rather than perfectly single-variable.
No goals, control setpoints, Offboard, arming, truth estimator input, or motion trajectory were used.
